last_batch.research: PubMed E-utilities searches covered 30 final fresh non-prescription irritable bowel syndrome self-management topics. The main query set returned 175 unique PubMed PMIDs, 174 fetched article records, and 173 abstracts available for inspection. Retained numeric effects or valid relative effects were verified for PMID records: 25070054, 26855665, 32935904, 30153721, 32314514, 35396764, 35807798, 40441496, 38958923, 41077057, 37391055, 32276950, 40358469, 35766861, 33872182, 31492643, 41144975, and 39839290. Nineteen retained PubMed references were added across 14 new entries. New entries cover soluble fiber, partially hydrolyzed guar gum, nopal fiber, aloe vera, vitamin D, acupuncture, gut-directed hypnotherapy, cognitive behavioral therapy, yoga, physical activity, digital self-management, online CBT, Mediterranean diet, and fermented foods. Low FODMAP diet, gluten-free diet, psyllium, probiotics, peppermint oil, and mindfulness topics were linked to existing entries. Simethicone, curcumin, omega-3, acupressure, tai chi, relaxation, breathing, stress management, sleep, and abdominal massage topics were screened out because the retrieved PubMed records did not provide a retained topic-specific numeric intervention-versus-control result or valid relative effect.
